_comment: B15-22 S8 amendment S8-B12 for Board 15 item 12 Mailers (Captain GO 2026-11-18, local; review Bones). TWO changes, chained from the bytes every earlier amendment leaves expected (no earlier link touches either file); no addition. lib/mailer-shared.ts: addressed incomplete mailer tasks with no (readable) due date get their own needsDueDate list instead of sorting into Overdue (No Address still first, every row in exactly one list); an unreadable due date no longer throws; the business-entity pattern uses (?<!\w)...(?!\w) edges so the dotted token L.L.C. matches (identical for every token that starts and ends with a letter). mailer-digest.ts: the Friday email lists the Needs due date rows and count. Read-only: no GHL write, request, authorization or send-path change. Hashes are LF-normalized.

netlify/functions/lib/mailer-shared.ts.reason: needsDueDate list (addressed, undated -> never Overdue); unreadable due date treated as undated; L.L.C. business-name match. No request, write or auth change.

netlify/functions/mailer-digest.ts.reason: Friday email: Needs due date section and count. Recipient lookup, Resend call, subject and suspension rule unchanged.
